name: smwgraphics-mega-man-bass-robot-museum-rainy-area
title: Mega Man & Bass - Robot Museum (Rainy Area)
description:
The background seen in the rainy section of the opening stage from Mega Man & Bass. Compared to the older version, this one saves much more space, does not have vanilla leftovers and has better palette row, in general. A good fit for mechanical stages.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.
